card.name: Inside words starting with pyro-
card.fires_on: The pole responds on the piece right after 'py' or 'Py' in rare technical words such as pyrochlore, pyrogallol, pyromorphite, pyrogenic and pyroxene. It also fires weakly on a few other mid-word pieces, such as the 'DC' in BPDCN.

modes.label: py-ro words
modes.description: The piece after 'py' in chemistry and mineral terms like pyrochlore, pyrogallol, pyroxene.

modes.label: Other partway pieces
modes.description: The middle or end piece of an acronym or long name, like BPDCN or Neurological.
